title: Pre-Closing Access for Improvements
tags: Access, Improvements, Renovations
snippet:
Seller hereby agrees that Buyer and Buyer's authorized representatives (including, but not limited to, licensed architects, general contractors, and design professionals) shall be permitted reasonable access to the Property prior to closing, for the limited purpose of planning improvements or renovations to the Property following Closing.

Such access shall:
* Be coordinated through Seller or Seller's agent,
* Require a minimum of 48 hours' written notice,
* Occur during normal business hours,
* Not interfere with Seller's use or occupancy of the Property,
* Be at Buyer's sole risk and expense.

Buyer agrees to indemnify, defend, and hold Seller harmless from any claims, damages, or liabilities arising out of such access, and shall ensure that any such professionals are appropriately licensed and insured. All other terms and conditions shall remain in full force and effect.

tags: Additional, HOA Estoppel Letter, Assessments, Special Assessments, Fines, Fees, Compliance Matters, Current Balances, Violations, Pending Assessments
snippet: All parties agree that Seller shall, at Seller's expense, obtain and deliver to Buyer, no later than [X] days prior to Closing, a written estoppel letter from the Homeowners' Association (or management company) confirming the status of all assessments, special assessments, fines, fees, and compliance matters affecting the Property. The estoppel letter shall reflect the current balances owed, if any, and confirm whether any violations or pending assessments exist as of the date of issuance. If the estoppel letter discloses unpaid charges, Seller shall satisfy such charges in full at or prior to Closing. All other terms and conditions shall remain in full force and effect.

title: Digital Signatures Authorization
tags: Additional, Digital Signatures, Electronic Signatures, DocuSign, Dotloop, Adobe Sign, Original Signatures, Binding Signatures
snippet: All parties agree that signatures transmitted electronically, including but not limited to DocuSign, Dotloop, Adobe Sign, or similar secure digital platforms, shall be deemed original and binding for all purposes under this Contract. All other terms and conditions shall remain in full force and effect.

title: Third-Party Approval Contingency
tags: Additional, Third-Party Approval, Probate Court, Corporate Seller, Relocation Company, Short Sale Approval, Contract Termination, Deposit Refund
snippet: All parties agree that this Contract is contingent upon the approval of [third party – e.g., probate court, corporate seller, relocation company, or lender short sale approval] no later than [date]. If such approval is not obtained by that date, either party may terminate the Contract and Buyer shall receive a refund of the Deposit. All other terms and conditions shall remain in full force and effect.

title: Flood Zone / Insurance Disclosure
tags: Additional, Flood Zone, Insurance Disclosure, Special Insurance Coverage, Contract Cancellation, Deposit Refund, Written Notice
snippet: All parties agree that if the Property is located in a designated flood zone or requires special insurance coverage as determined by Buyer's lender or insurance provider, Buyer shall have [X] days from receipt of written notice to cancel this Contract by written notice to Seller, in which case the Deposit shall be refunded to Buyer. All other terms and conditions shall remain in full force and effect.

title: Buyer Deposit Protection
tags: Additional, Buyer Deposit Protection, Short Sale, Lender Approval, Unacceptable Conditions, Immediate Refund
snippet: All parties agree that in the event the Short Sale is not approved by Seller's Lender, or if approval is granted subject to conditions unacceptable to Buyer, Buyer shall be entitled to an immediate refund of the Deposit without further action. All other terms and conditions shall remain in full force and effect.

title: Buyer's Right to Cancel After X Days
tags: Additional, Buyer's Right to Cancel, Short Sale Approval, Timeline, Written Notice, Deposit Refund
snippet: All parties agree that if Short Sale Approval has not been received within [X] days of the Effective Date, Buyer may terminate this Contract by written notice to Seller and receive a refund of the Deposit. All other terms and conditions shall remain in full force and effect.

title: Appraisal Contingency Overlay
tags: Additional, Appraisal Contingency, Short Sale, Purchase Price, Financing, Contract Cancellation, Deposit Refund
snippet: All parties agree that in addition to Short Sale Approval, this Contract is contingent upon the subject property appraising at or above the Purchase Price for Buyer's financing purposes. If the Property does not appraise, Buyer may cancel this Contract and the Deposit shall be refunded to Buyer. All other terms and conditions shall remain in full force and effect.

title: Lender Processing Delays
tags: Additional, Lender Processing Delays, Short Sale, Multiple Review Levels, Seller's Lender, No Liability
snippet: All parties agree that Seller and Buyer acknowledge Short Sale processing is controlled by Seller's Lender and may require multiple levels of review. Neither Seller nor Buyer shall be liable for delays caused solely by Seller's Lender, provided both parties comply with their obligations under this Contract. All other terms and conditions shall remain in full force and effect.

title: Backup Offer Handling
tags: Additional, Backup Offer Handling, Written Notice, Buyer Option, Continue or Terminate, Deposit Refund
snippet: All parties agree that if Seller elects to accept a back-up offer during the pendency of this Contract, Seller shall provide Buyer with written notice of same. Buyer shall then have the option to continue under this Contract or terminate and receive a refund of the Deposit. All other terms and conditions shall remain in full force and effect.

title: Cash Buyer Short Sale
tags: Additional, Cash Buyer, Short Sale, No Financing, Lender Approval, Approval Deadline, Extension Option, Contract Termination
snippet: All parties agree that although Buyer is not obtaining financing for the purchase of the Property, this Contract remains contingent upon Seller's Lender(s) approving the Short Sale on or before [X] days from the Effective Date ("Approval Deadline"). If Short Sale Approval has not been received by the Approval Deadline, Buyer may, at Buyer's option, (a) extend the Approval Deadline once for up to [Y] days by written notice to Seller, or (b) terminate this Contract by written notice to Seller, in which event the Deposit shall be refunded to Buyer, thereby releasing Buyer and Seller from all further obligations under this Contract. All other terms and conditions shall remain in full force and effect.
